q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of a clutch plate?
title: Clutch plate carbon footprint per piece
short: Add the steel stampings, springs and friction facings per plate with supplier figures, then add stamping, riveting, heat treatment and testing energy. Divide the plant's energy by plates passed.
audience: Clutch makers and auto component suppliers

ul: Steel sheet for the plate and hub.

p: Report per plate by vehicle type, since a truck clutch is much heavier than a two-wheeler one.

example.title: Worked example: clutch plate unit per piece (one month)
lines: Plant total: 27,450 / 50,000 = 0.549 kg CO2 per piece
Add steel and facings for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
